sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r12/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 35 = check 34; Internal Quality Checks row 35, no extra annotation columns)
evidence: Every criterion that concerns interaction, time, or viewport tells the judge to act, and none scores a still first paint. (1) Waits: tests/scored/functional/prompt.md Action rules: 'Where waiting is required, wait the stated time; do not shorten it.' Criteria state the waits: cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget 'Wait until the run has finished, then wait at least eight more seconds ... Click the first button: its marker must appear about a second later'; cw_stop_cancels_pending_work 'press Stop as your very next action after Run ... Then wait at least eight more seconds', with a 2 s positive control and a void-and-repeat rule; cw_newer_run_supersedes same structure with a 4 s control; cw_time_limit_recovery 'within about ten seconds a visible time-limit reason must appear ... do not demand sub-second precision'; cw_live_library_update 'without reloading or pressing anything in A, watch its library for up to ten seconds'; cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft 'Within ten seconds and without any action in A'. (2) Interaction: app_context.md requires 'real key presses', 'driving the real mouse and keyboard at coordinates' and forbids synthetic events; the editor criteria name the gestures (double/triple click, drag, Alt+Click, Ctrl/Cmd+Click, Tab/Shift+Tab, Ctrl+End). Scroll-follow is exercised, not inspected statically: cw_caret_kept_in_view 'the editor must have scrolled by itself ... keep typing until the line is clearly wider than the editor'. In-preview interaction is exercised: cw_html_preview 'clicking the button in the preview must change the visible text', cw_last_good_recovery types into the preview input and clicks its canvas button. Even the render gate types and reloads ('Click into the code editing area and type one short distinctive word ... Reload the page'). (3) Viewport: polish cw_narrow_width_usable 'Resize the browser viewport to about 390 by 844 pixels and reload ... By scrolling only vertically, reach the code editor, the Run control, the preview, the console and the library. At this width type a short line ... and press the Run control ... Restore the desktop viewport afterwards', matching ui.md 'At a phone width of about 390 px ... usable without sideways page scrolling'. (4) State toggles: cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus moves focus with Tab before judging the indicator; cw_undo_redo_availability checks disabled state at three points across a type and an Undo; cw_unsaved_marker checks the marker across save, edit, undo, save; cw_focus_returns_to_code types after each of five actions. (5) Visual is not a first paint: visual/prompt.md 'put a ten-line JavaScript draft in the editor and Run it once ... Then click into the code, select one word with a double click, and watch the caret for about two seconds, because a caret may blink'; the golden caret does blink (style.css:19-21 'animation:cw-caret 1s step-end infinite'). The app has no theme switch and no animation requirement, so theming is N-A. Run evidence: no configured judge run exists for these bytes. The hosted run on the earlier candidate (hashes verified) shows the configured judge really performing these actions on near-identical criteria: Stop 'pressed 146ms after Run', newer Run 'started 286ms after the old one', '9s after a run finished, clicking the preview's One button produced DELAYED-MARKER ~1s later', 'Viewport resized to 390x844 and reloaded: ... scrollWidth 390 = clientWidth 390', caret 'visible ... in three consecutive 120 ms clips and absent in the fourth'. Scripted golden on these bytes passes all of these criteria (runtime.json, polish.json) but is not a judge run. Weak-app check: a static shell or an app with dead timers, a non-following editor, or a desktop-only layout cannot pass the cited criteria because each demands an observed change after an action or wait. Notes, neither a row-34 defect: (a) visual/prompt.md asks the judge to 'take your screenshots with that selection in place' while cw_visual_editor_readability also rates 'the visibility of the caret'; an editor that hides its caret while a range is selected (the native text-field convention, not forbidden by ui.md) could be marked down by a literal judge. The earlier judge avoided this by clicking once separately, and exposure is at most one likert point on one of three visual criteria (P3). (b) The two live-update criteria allow ten seconds where behaviour.md says 'within about five seconds'; this is lenient toward the submission and is a waiting step either way. The 390 px criterion text changed since the hosted run (output of Run is no longer required there), so the hosted observation is supporting, not a measurement of these bytes.
